title: Match
description: Sports match or game with teams, scores, sport type, league, venue, status, match date, and attendance. Used for sports databases, match tracking, and sports management systems.

sport.description: Sport type (e.g., Football, Basketball, Soccer, Tennis)

stadium.description: Name of the stadium or venue where the match is played

city.description: City where the match takes place

status.description: Match status (e.g., scheduled, live, finished, postponed, cancelled)

match_date.description: Date and time when the match is scheduled or was played

attendance.description: Number of spectators who attended the match
